name: Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphin
desc: Eats a wide range of fish and squid. Some Shark Bay dolphins wear marine sponges on their snouts, seemingly as tools to probe the seabed for fish.
about: The Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphin is a species of bottlenose dolphin. This dolphin grows to 2.6 m (8.5 ft) long, and weighs up to 230 kg (510 lb).
